categories.main_business_segments: Shihlin Paper Corp. operates primarily in consumer goods with two main brands: Baby Lion, focusing on wet wipes, anti-mosquito, anti-pandemic, and baby wash products; and Forest Beauty, specializing in skincare products including facial masks and related items. Additionally, the company is involved in real estate development, urban renewal, hotel rental business, and investment in related businesses.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced manufacturing processes for wet wipes, toiletries, anti-mosquito products, alcohol-based protective products, and facial masks, including raw material inspection, compounding, blending, quality control, filling, sealing, and packaging. It emphasizes eco-friendly materials, natural and harmless ingredients, and has obtained international certifications for its products. The R&D team actively develops patented formulas and functional products, collaborating with academic and government research units.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include consumers in Taiwan and international markets for Baby Lion and Forest Beauty products, with distribution through e-commerce platforms, maternity and baby stores, pharmacies, chain cosmetics stores, and general retail. The company also serves the real estate and hospitality sectors through its development and hotel businesses. Major sales regions are northern, central, and southern Taiwan, with growing presence in countries such as China, Hong Kong, Macau, Japan, Singapore, Russia, Georgia, and Romania.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company primarily operates in Taiwan, focusing on northern, central, and southern regions for consumer products and real estate development. It has expanded its skincare product exports to Europe (EU), Southeast Asia (Indonesia, Singapore), and other international markets including China, Japan, Russia, Georgia, and Romania. The hotel and real estate development projects are concentrated in Taipei City and Taoyuan City.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shihlin Paper Corp. operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on product development, manufacturing (often through OEM partnerships), branding, marketing, and distribution. It outsources raw materials and collaborates with professional OEM manufacturers to ensure product quality and innovation. The company also engages in real estate development and hotel operations, representing downstream service provision.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in consumer goods with a focus on natural, safe, and effective products, expanding product lines in wet wipes and skincare with patented formulas. It emphasizes marketing-oriented growth, brand revitalization, and international market expansion. R&D efforts include collaboration with academic and government units, product registration in multiple countries, and continuous development of differentiated and customized products. The company also focuses on sustainable development, environmental protection, and information security.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of Baby Lion and Forest Beauty branded consumer goods, including wet wipes, skincare, and toiletries. Additional revenue streams come from real estate development, urban renewal projects, hotel rental and operations, and wholesale distribution. The company leverages both physical retail and e-commerce channels, including online shopping platforms and membership management systems.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: While specific competitors are not named, Shihlin Paper positions itself as a leading brand in Taiwan’s consumer goods market with strong recognition for quality and innovation in wet wipes and skincare products. It competes in a crowded domestic market with many brands, emphasizing product differentiation, patented formulas, and environmental friendliness. The company aims to strengthen its international brand presence and maintain competitive advantages through OEM partnerships and diversified marketing strategies.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2024, the company reported net operating income of approximately NTD 155.8 million, a decrease of 8.96% from the previous year, with a gross operating profit increase of 10.05%. It experienced a net operating loss of NTD 48.3 million, an improvement from the prior year. Total assets increased by 17.87% to about NTD 10.27 billion, and equity attributable to owners grew by 22.62%. The company is investing significantly in hotel construction and real estate development, indicating a growth trajectory with diversification into property and hospitality sectors.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Shihlin Paper emphasizes high-quality, safe, and environmentally friendly products with natural plant extracts and patented formulas, catering to specific consumer needs such as infant care, anti-mosquito protection, and skincare. The Baby Lion and Forest Beauty brands focus on product innovation, efficacy, and consumer trust, supported by rigorous testing and international certifications. The company also differentiates through integrated marketing strategies, combining online and offline channels, and by expanding into international markets with recognized product quality and brand reputation.
